summary.name: Hand-drawn Collage (category: Printmaking and Craft Materials; provenance explicit). Source-described craft-layered paper style.
summary.visualIdentity: Explicit: drawn characters, handwritten text and cut paper share one brush-and-paper language. Uneven edges, tape and light contact shadows support the craft. Layers are placed, peeled or hinged, not continuously wobbling.
summary.suitableUses: Source-named: crafted narratives, which work alone. Explicit hybrids suit explainers with diagrams and craft stories or social clips with stepped placement. Inferred: other audiences and objectives are unspecified.
summary.limitations: Rough.js adds no handwriting, paper texture or poses, so keep precise text clean. Palette and motion examples are brand-specific, not rules. Source review sampled only seconds 1–8, with no audio or later scenes verified.
summary.palette: Background is scene-dependent, chosen from subject, lighting and mood, and not defaulted to cream. Illustrative, unapproved tokens: background #F6EDD9, foreground #3C4345, accent_1 #B97259, accent_2 #819777. Foreground on background measures 8.666:1; accents are decorative only (about 3.2:1). Task-provided exact colors override these; gradients are disabled. Reviewed sources suggest a low-chroma ground, paper distinct from it, near-black ink, and few saturated accents for tape, pins and annotations.
summary.motionAndInteraction: Explicit: placing, peeling and hinged movement with explicit pivots, without continuous wobble. Video runs on a paused, seekable GSAP timeline; no pointer or scroll input is required. Optional references, used only when scene assets support them: gaze following (motion-006, needs eye layers), pinned recomposition (motion-007), chapter handoff (motion-012), story steps (motion-015), paper-letter peel (motion-037), and cut-paper punctuation zoom (motion-038).
summary.audio: Unspecified by the style; no fixed genre, tempo, voice or mandatory layer is defined. Weigh background music, voiceover, sound effects, ambience or silence against the topic and audience. Without supplied audio, propose a direction and state assumptions; do not silently default to instrumental music. Keep speech intelligible and free of competing vocals.
summary.assetRequirements: Explicit: transparent layers or numbered frames with alpha, consistent dimensions and a layer manifest. Keep paper pieces, lettering and character parts separate, with shared paper textures and explicit pivots. Inspect assets and load local fonts before composition. Motion-006 needs eye layers or a rig; motion-037 and motion-038 need real glyph or punctuation assets.
summary.combinations: style-097: Rough.js diagrams drawn on paper pieces, using the primary palette only, a consistent ink weight and accurate data; avoid glossy charts, overlapping layers and wobbling diagrams. style-082: stepped timing for placements only, with no line boil, shared paper textures and no added colors; avoid continuous wobble.
summary.productionApproach: HyperFrames is the default for composition, seekable timing, validation and export; Remotion is fallback only with a recorded verified reason. GSAP is the single seekable motion owner. Optional PixiJS or seeded Rough.js layers render from composition time, with Canvas 2D as an alternative. Python with Pillow prepares assets, and chroma.js checks contrast. Verify snapshots, direct and reverse seeks, audio sync and loop seams.
